experiments.stop_rule: Do not promote a source outside the frozen discovery universe or one that lacks at least ten complete participants, synchronized EOG and task-relevant EMG for every relevant effector, named geometry, joint cue/pre-cue/posterior/timing/derangement controls, a reusable license, exact 12+2+2+1+3 GiB storage fit, or a remotely green transport witness.

experiments.expected_information_gain: High after source admission because the test directly separates a neural increment from eye, muscle or kinematic, posterior, cue, timing, and derangement alternatives.
